foreman_greet: Welcome to Motorworks, kid. Name's Sal. Walk up to that kiosk, build yourself a monster, and my crew will bolt it together before the moon is up.
foreman_2: Careful on the line. The robots don't stop for trick-or-treaters.
foreman_3: Twenty two years I've run this floor. Never seen a hearse come through with a supercharger. Until tonight.
foreman_order: Order received! The line is rolling. Walk along the conveyor, or hit V for the station cameras.
foreman_done: She's done, kid. Keys are in it. Take her up to the old cemetery and see what she can do.
skeleton_1: Hey there! I'm Bones. I'd shake your hand, but I'm a little short handed. Get it? Ha!
skeleton_2: I love welding. It really gets me right in the funny bone.
skeleton_3: Why didn't the skeleton go to the Halloween party? He had no body to go with! Except you, pal.
skeleton_4: I've been on this line so long, I'm practically skin and bones. Well. Mostly bones.
skeleton_5: Safety glasses? Nah. I've got nothing to lose. No eyes, see?
groundskeeper_1: Turn back, traveler. The fog is thick tonight, and the dead are restless.
groundskeeper_2: They say if you honk three times at the old Vlad crypt, the Phantom Hearse comes calling.
groundskeeper_3: The Graveyard Shift trial starts at the gates. Drift through the stones, if you dare.
groundskeeper_4: The police won't follow you far into this fog. Even the law fears this place after dark.
gy_finish: You survived the Graveyard Shift. The dead applaud you.
waitress_1: Hiya hon! Pumpkin pie is fresh and the coffee is hot. Anything else, you'll have to ask the ghost in booth four.
waitress_2: We're open all night. Especially tonight. Especially for the regulars.
waitress_3: Somebody said there are five golden pumpkins hidden around town. Find them all and Sal's shop gives you something special.
panic_1: Hey! That's my car! Somebody call the cops!
panic_2: No no no! Not my car! I just washed it!
civilian_1: Happy Halloween! Watch out for the cops, they're itching for a chase tonight.
civilian_2: Have you seen the spider on the Motorworks sign? I swear it moved.
civilian_3: My kid wants to be a hot rod for Halloween. Can you believe that?
civilian_4: The hardware store sold out of fake cobwebs. Turns out the real ones were free.
dispatch_1: All units, all units. Reported vehicle theft on Main Street. Suspect is armed with a very nice paint job.
dispatch_2: Dispatch to all cars. Suspect is fleeing at high speed. Pursue and intercept.
dispatch_3: Code three. Suspect vehicle heading toward the cemetery. Be advised, visibility is near zero.
dispatch_4: All units, we have lost visual on the suspect. Resume patrol.
dispatch_5: Suspect is in custody. Nice work everybody. Somebody bring donuts.
dispatch_6: Units be advised, reckless driving reported in town. Multiple mailboxes down.
dispatch_7: Officer reports suspect rammed a patrol car. Escalating response. All available units.
cop_busted: Busted! Out of the car, nice and slow. That is going to cost you.
cop_1: Evening, citizen. Keep it under the speed limit. It's a busy night for ghouls.
dj_intro: You're tuned to W H O O, sixty six point six F M. The only station broadcasting live from beyond the grave. Here's some synthwave to haunt your highway.
dj_2: This is the Wolfman Jack O Lantern, spinning tunes all night long. If you see a hearse with no driver, do not, I repeat, do not race it.
dj_3: Weather tonight. Fog, more fog, and a ninety percent chance of screaming. Back to the music.
dj_4: Big shout out to the night crew at Motorworks. Keep those robots oiled, and keep your doors locked.
kiosk_welcome: Welcome to the Motorworks configurator. Choose your chassis, your paint, and your poison.
kiosk_order: Order confirmed. Your build has entered the assembly line.
kiosk_unlock: Monster Mash pack unlocked. It's alive! It's alive!
kiosk_bay: Custom bay ready. Fresh paint and new plates will clear any heat on this vehicle.
phantom_1: Who dares summon me? Race me to the town gas station, mortal. If you can keep up.
phantom_win: Impossible. You have beaten the Phantom. The road is yours, tonight.
phantom_lose: Too slow, mortal. Your soul, and your pink slip, belong to the night.
pa_1: Attention Motorworks staff. Station two, please stop feeding the skeleton. He has no stomach for it.
pa_2: Reminder. The employee costume contest is at midnight. Masks must not obstruct welding visors.
worker_1: Stamping thirty tons a hit. Stand back, it gets loud.
worker_2: Paint booth is running hot tonight. Midnight pearl is the big seller.
worker_3: Engine marriage is the best part. The crane drops the heart right into the body.
worker_4: Final check. Lights, doors, hood, trunk. If it opens and shuts, it ships.
worker_5: Boo! Ha, got you. It's the mask, right?
bay_1: Fresh coat of paint and new plates. Nobody will recognize this ride now.
civm_1: Evening! Watch your step, half the town is dressed like zombies tonight.
civm_2: I just pulled a double shift at the plant, and now my wife wants me to carve twelve pumpkins.
civm_3: Between my mortgage and the candy bill, Halloween is scarier than any ghost.
civm_4: Saw a hearse doing donuts up by the cemetery. Nobody was driving it, I swear.
panicm_1: Hey! That's my ride! Somebody call the sheriff!
panicm_2: Whoa, whoa! Get out of my truck! Help!
panicm_3: My car! I just made the last payment on that thing!
kidb_1: Trick or treat! Look at my candy bag, it's almost full!
kidb_2: Whoa, cool hot-rod, mister! Can it go a hundred?
kidb_3: I'm a superhero tonight. I can fly! Well... almost.
kidg_1: Trick or treat, smell my feet, give me something good to eat!
kidg_2: I'm a witch! I'm gonna turn you into a pumpkin!
kidg_3: My ghost costume has real glow-in-the-dark eyes. Boo!
homem_greet: Happy Halloween! Great costume. Here, grab a handful of candy.
homem_panic: Get out of my house! I'm calling the police right now!
homef_greet: Oh, how fun! Happy Halloween, sweetie. Take some candy, and a couple of bucks too.
homef_panic: Burglar! Get out of my house! I'm calling the police!
cop_stop_2: Freeze! Hands where I can see them!
cop_shoot: Drop the weapon! Shots fired, shots fired!
dispatch_8: All units, shots fired on Main Street. Suspect is armed and dangerous.
dispatch_9: Burglary in progress reported in the residential district. Units respond.
fence_1: Nice haul. No questions asked. Cash on the barrel.
fence_2: Bring me the good stuff. TVs, jewelry, whatever fell off a truck.
clerk_1: Welcome to Hank's Hardware. Tools, ammo, jerrycans, and masks for the big night.
gas_1: Pump's on, hon. Two bucks a gallon, and don't you drive off without paying.
